tools.name: actions-runner.setup
tools.description: Register a GitHub Actions runner. Refuses a public repo unless the operator overrides it. Requires a Cloudflare Access JWT.

tools.name: actions-runner.check
tools.description: Check the actions-runner unit recorded by actions-runner.setup.

tools.name: actions-runner.uninstall
tools.description: Delete the actions-runner folder under the self-hosted home. That folder holds the install, config, and state actions-runner.setup wrote.
